verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show sandbox.exec() for arbitrary shell command execution with stdout/stderr/exit codes, stdin support, real-time output streaming, and Docker command execution inside the sandbox — covering both shell commands and effectively package installs via exec/docker. Community discussion corroborates real-world usage of similar sandbox execution features without disputing this core capability. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party example of package-manager install commands (e.g. npm/pip install) or independent hands-on confirmation of arbitrary package installation.
